spots.name: Roughlock Falls
spots.tip: Best under soft overcast or in shade so the highlights don't blow out. A slow shutter (1/4–1 s on a tripod) smooths the water; flow peaks after rain and snowmelt. About 18 m (59 ft) tall.

spots.name: Spearfish Falls
spots.tip: Best under soft overcast or in shade so the highlights don't blow out. A slow shutter (1/4–1 s on a tripod) smooths the water; flow peaks after rain and snowmelt. About 14 m (46 ft) tall.

spots.name: Bullock Lookout Tower
spots.tip: A lookout tower or fire lookout: a full-circle view, so it works at sunrise and sunset. Many are staffed in summer and some can be rented.

spots.name: Scenic Overlook
